name: r3-ws-coop-widec
author: solx-loop
description: Lineage D / E3 (H25). One cooperative launch for the six wide-C small-image rows. Each of 128 CTAs (512 threads, 1 CTA/SM) owns whole-image token tiles and one hidden slice (GEMM1), then one c-slice x k-split (GEMM2). The fp32 W1/W2 32-k chunks stream through a 4-stage TMA ring (128B swizzle) and are converted once per chunk into fp16 smem, with lnw or the per-image GRN scale folded in.
